about: Tests set aside after failing and then passing on a retry (How we ship: a flaky test is retried once in the merge queue, then set aside the same day with an owner, and fixed within a day). At most five. Each entry: file (repo-relative), name as the FAIL line shows it after the file ('describe > it'), owner, issue (this repo's GitHub issue), since (YYYY-MM-DD), and optionally platform (darwin, linux or win32). Remove the entry in the PR that fixes the test.
